gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.duc) Game Save (North America)

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header written by a converter ('Converted Savegame' / 'Savegame', ASCII 'shuny conv'), then 256 KiB raw for the 512 KiB flash (padded 262144 -> 524288 with 0xFF)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-ards.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 524288 --stem 'Pokemon - Diamond Version (Europe) (Rev 5)' --out DIR: drops the Action Replay header; fits it to the 524288-byte chip (padded 262144 -> 524288 with 0xFF) and writes each core's file

note: Release: Diamond/Pearl layout, English; Diamond from the version that caught the player's own Pokemon (origin game in the decrypted Pokemon data, OT matching the trainer). Every core shows "The save file has been erased due to corruption or damage." and then Professor Rowan's introduction. Only the first 256 KiB was uploaded; its blocks pass their CRC-16, but the game still rejects the save, in all six cores alike. The library's image of this game code is the Pokemon - Diamond Version (Europe) (Rev 5) release; the save was run in it, since both releases share the game code.
